note: Few-shot examples for the text-to-SQL prompt. Written from the design schema; run each once against NI_hackathon_data and fix names (e.g. 'Humana Inc.') before the demo. Every example passes sqlGuard.

examples.question: How many providers does each payer have in network in Dallas County, Texas?
examples.sql:
SELECT TOP 15 po.ParentOrganizationName, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.NPI) AS Providers
FROM NetworkProviderMapping npm
JOIN ProviderLocation pl ON pl.ProviderLocationId = npm.ProviderLocationId
JOIN County c ON c.FIPS = pl.FIPS
JOIN ParentOrganization po ON po.ParentOrganizationId = npm.ParentOrganizationId
WHERE c.StateCode = 'TX' AND c.CountyName LIKE 'Dallas%'
GROUP BY po.ParentOrganizationName
ORDER BY Providers DESC

examples.question: Compare Humana and UnitedHealthcare cardiologists in Harris County
examples.sql:
SELECT po.ParentOrganizationName, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.NPI) AS Cardiologists
FROM NetworkProviderMapping npm
JOIN ProviderLocation pl ON pl.ProviderLocationId = npm.ProviderLocationId
JOIN County c ON c.FIPS = pl.FIPS
JOIN ParentOrganization po ON po.ParentOrganizationId = npm.ParentOrganizationId
JOIN ProviderSpecialityMapping psm ON psm.NPI = pl.NPI AND psm.SpecialityFlag = 'Primary'
JOIN Speciality sp ON sp.SpecialityCode = psm.SpecialityCode
WHERE c.StateCode = 'TX' AND c.CountyName LIKE 'Harris%'
  AND sp.HWAISpecialtyDescription LIKE '%cardio%'
  AND (po.ParentOrganizationName LIKE '%humana%' OR po.ParentOrganizationName LIKE '%unitedhealth%')
GROUP BY po.ParentOrganizationName

examples.question: Which specialties does Humana have fewer providers in than UnitedHealthcare in Bell County?
examples.sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT sp.HWAISpecialtyDescription AS Specialty,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN po.ParentOrganizationName LIKE '%humana%' THEN pl.NPI END) AS Humana,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN po.ParentOrganizationName LIKE '%unitedhealth%' THEN pl.NPI END) AS UnitedHealthcare
  FROM NetworkProviderMapping npm
  JOIN ProviderLocation pl ON pl.ProviderLocationId = npm.ProviderLocationId
  JOIN County c ON c.FIPS = pl.FIPS
  JOIN ParentOrganization po ON po.ParentOrganizationId = npm.ParentOrganizationId
  JOIN ProviderSpecialityMapping psm ON psm.NPI = pl.NPI AND psm.SpecialityFlag = 'Primary'
  JOIN Speciality sp ON sp.SpecialityCode = psm.SpecialityCode
  WHERE c.StateCode = 'TX' AND c.CountyName LIKE 'Bell%'
  GROUP BY sp.HWAISpecialtyDescription
)
SELECT TOP 20 Specialty, Humana, UnitedHealthcare, UnitedHealthcare - Humana AS Gap
FROM counts
WHERE UnitedHealthcare > Humana
ORDER BY Gap DESC

examples.question: Which hospitals in Bell County are in UnitedHealthcare networks but in no Humana network?
examples.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT hd.HosptitalName, hd.City, hs.HealthSystem, hs.MedicareCertifiedBeds
FROM HospitalDetails hd
JOIN County c ON c.FIPS = hd.FIPS
LEFT JOIN HospitalScores hs ON hs.HospitalId = hd.HospitalId
WHERE c.StateCode = 'TX' AND c.CountyName LIKE 'Bell%'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM NetworkHospitalMapping nhm
    JOIN NetworkProviderMapping npm ON npm.NetworkId = nhm.NetworkId
    JOIN ParentOrganization po ON po.ParentOrganizationId = npm.ParentOrganizationId
    WHERE nhm.HospitalId = hd.HospitalId AND po.ParentOrganizationName LIKE '%unitedhealth%')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM NetworkHospitalMapping nhm
    JOIN NetworkProviderMapping npm ON npm.NetworkId = nhm.NetworkId
    JOIN ParentOrganization po ON po.ParentOrganizationId = npm.ParentOrganizationId
    WHERE nhm.HospitalId = hd.HospitalId AND po.ParentOrganizationName LIKE '%humana%')

examples.question: Which networks include Baylor University Medical Center?
examples.sql:
SELECT TOP 50 n.NetworkId, n.NetworkName, n.Carrier_Name, n.NetworkCategory
FROM HospitalDetails hd
JOIN NetworkHospitalMapping nhm ON nhm.HospitalId = hd.HospitalId
JOIN Network n ON n.NetworkId = nhm.NetworkId
WHERE hd.HosptitalName LIKE '%Baylor University Medical%'
ORDER BY n.Carrier_Name, n.NetworkName

examples.question: If Baylor Scott & White leaves Humana, how many Humana in-network providers in Texas are affiliated with Baylor hospitals?
examples.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pl.NPI) AS AffiliatedProviders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pl.FIPS) AS Counties
FROM NetworkProviderMapping npm
JOIN ProviderLocation pl ON pl.ProviderLocationId = npm.ProviderLocationId
JOIN County c ON c.FIPS = pl.FIPS
JOIN ParentOrganization po ON po.ParentOrganizationId = npm.ParentOrganizationId
WHERE c.StateCode = 'TX'
  AND po.ParentOrganizationName LIKE '%humana%'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ProviderHospitalAffiliation pha
              WHERE pha.NPI = pl.NPI AND pha.HealthSystem LIKE '%Baylor Scott%')

examples.question: MA enrollment by payer in McLennan County
examples.sql:
SELECT TOP 15 po.ParentOrganizationName, SUM(ed.Enrollment) AS Enrollment
FROM EnrollmentDetails ed
JOIN County c ON c.FIPS = ed.FIPS
JOIN PlanGeographyMapping pgm ON pgm.BidId = ed.BidId
JOIN GeographyPlanFilters gpf ON gpf.GeographyPlanFiltersId = pgm.GeographyPlanFiltersId AND gpf.FIPS = ed.FIPS
JOIN ParentOrganization po ON po.ParentOrganizationId = gpf.ParentOrganizationId
WHERE c.StateCode = 'TX' AND c.CountyName LIKE 'McLennan%'
GROUP BY po.ParentOrganizationName
ORDER BY Enrollment DESC

examples.question: Top physician groups in Humana's Dallas County network by number of providers
examples.sql:
SELECT TOP 10 g.GroupName, g.GroupTIN, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.NPI) AS InNetworkProviders
FROM NetworkProviderMapping npm
JOIN ProviderLocation pl ON pl.ProviderLocationId = npm.ProviderLocationId
JOIN County c ON c.FIPS = pl.FIPS
JOIN ParentOrganization po ON po.ParentOrganizationId = npm.ParentOrganizationId
JOIN ProviderGroupAffiliation pga ON pga.NPI = pl.NPI AND pga.PrimaryGroupAffiliation = 1
JOIN GroupDetails g ON g.GroupTIN = pga.GroupTIN
WHERE c.StateCode = 'TX' AND c.CountyName LIKE 'Dallas%' AND po.ParentOrganizationName LIKE '%humana%'
GROUP BY g.GroupName, g.GroupTIN
ORDER BY InNetworkProviders DESC

examples.question: How many in-network oncologists does each payer have within 30 miles of Bell County?
examples.sql:
WITH target AS (SELECT c.FIPS FROM County c WHERE c.StateCode = 'TX' AND c.CountyName LIKE 'Bell%')
SELECT TOP 15 po.ParentOrganizationName, COUNT(DISTINCT m.NPI) AS OncologistsWithin30mi
FROM MilesIndividual_30 m
JOIN target t ON t.FIPS = m.Isochrone_FIPS
JOIN Speciality sp ON sp.SpecialityCode = m.SpecialityCode
JOIN ProviderLocation pl ON pl.NPI = m.NPI AND pl.FIPS = m.NPI_FIPS
JOIN NetworkProviderMapping npm ON npm.ProviderLocationId = pl.ProviderLocationId
JOIN ParentOrganization po ON po.ParentOrganizationId = npm.ParentOrganizationId
WHERE sp.HWAISpecialtyDescription LIKE '%oncolog%'
GROUP BY po.ParentOrganizationName
ORDER BY OncologistsWithin30mi DESC

examples.question: List the plans that use Humana networks in Texas with their star ratings
examples.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT TOP 50 pnm.BidId, p.PlanName, p.OverAllStarRating, n.NetworkName
FROM PlanNetworkMapping pnm
JOIN Network n ON n.NetworkId = pnm.NetworkId
LEFT JOIN PlanDetails p ON p.BidId = pnm.BidId
WHERE n.Carrier_Name LIKE '%humana%'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM PlanGeographyMapping pgm
              JOIN GeographyPlanFilters gpf ON gpf.GeographyPlanFiltersId = pgm.GeographyPlanFiltersId
              JOIN County c ON c.FIPS = gpf.FIPS
              WHERE pgm.BidId = pnm.BidId AND c.StateCode = 'TX')
ORDER BY p.OverAllStarRating DESC
